title: Supervisor Orchestration with Roster and Spawn Budget
description: A supervisor loop delegates to a fixed roster of sub-agents (researcher, writer, critic) with a hard spawn budget cap. It shows the three levers that keep a dynamic system safe: roster, budget, and stop condition.
source: draft: omp free model + edit: codex

steps.description: The chat function makes one request to a local OpenAI-compatible endpoint (Ollama at localhost:11434) and returns the assistant's text response.
The ROSTER dictionary defines three sub-agents with one-sentence system prompts: researcher gathers 3 bullet points, writer makes one paragraph, critic lists problems or says OK.
SPAWN_BUDGET = 6 sets a hard cap on sub-agent calls, the stop condition of last resort.
The supervise function runs a loop up to SPAWN_BUDGET times. Each iteration asks the supervisor LLM for a JSON decision: call a sub-agent or stop with an answer.
The supervisor prompt lists available sub-agents from ROSTER and specifies the exact JSON format for call or stop actions.

steps.question: What happens if the supervisor's reply is not valid JSON?
steps.answer: the loop breaks safely with a JSONDecodeError catch

steps.description: On a valid call action, the code checks the agent is in ROSTER (closed-set guard). It then dispatches the sub-agent with its system prompt and input, appending the result to the transcript.
If the budget exhausts without a stop action, the function returns the transcript with a flag showing it was cut off.
The final line runs supervise on a sample task, producing a researched paragraph that has been critiqued and approved.
